name: print-social-grow-your-business-template-full-view-with-watermarked-navy-band
title: Grow Your Business Template Full View
whatItIs: The full square template on a white and navy split background: an azure block, a tall azure pill at the left, a white card with a heavy navy 'Grow Your Business' headline and paragraph, and a column of outlined half-shapes and a circle at the right, with a wide empty pill at the base.
whatItMeans: The whole layout shows how a few basic shapes and one card make a confident business post.
techniques: White card floating over colour blocks
Empty outlined pill as a decorative or text placeholder
Navy band under the lower half of the canvas
Fine-line arcs in a right column

vocabulary.definition: An empty shape kept for later content.
A background divided into two colour zones.
A card layered on top of a busy background.
